item.title: By: carl
item.dc:creator: carl
item.description: Yes, it appears that we need to be hit over the head with over whelming evidence. Yet, even then, we cling to whatever we believe. Emotion trumps reason every time. It is very humbling to see ourselves as the animals we actually are, as opposed to the ideal we think we are!

item.title: By: Lynn Cornish
item.dc:creator: Lynn Cornish
item.description: It's funny how science proves things we already know. Just watching my grandchildren, on the floor, surrounded by toys. She goes for the doll, he goes for the truck.
